name: Generation Quality v1
description: Evaluates the quality of code and UI generation across a range of project descriptions, from simple to complex.

input.text: Build a simple landing page with a hero section, features grid, and contact form
Build a todo application with user authentication, task categories, due dates, and a responsive mobile-first design
Build a real-time analytics dashboard with line charts, bar charts, and a data table. Include dark mode toggle and responsive layout.
Build a product detail page for an e-commerce site with image gallery, variant selector, add-to-cart button, reviews section, and related products carousel
Create a blog platform with a markdown editor, categories, tags, search, and an admin dashboard for managing posts
Build a real-time chat application with multiple channels, direct messages, user presence indicators, and message search
Generate an API documentation website with endpoint listing, request/response examples, authentication guide, and interactive try-it-out panels
Build a Kanban-style project management board with drag-and-drop cards, swimlanes, assignees, labels, due dates, and a calendar view
Create a SaaS pricing page with three tiers, feature comparison table, toggle between monthly and annual billing, and FAQ accordion

Build a social media application with user profiles, a news feed with infinite scroll, post creation with image upload, likes, comments, follow/unfollow, notifications, and a responsive mobile layout with dark mode
